organization.name: ARFADA
organization.description: A monitoring, evaluation, assessment and research firm delivering independent third-party data collection and analysis for international organizations, UN agencies, and NGOs.

capabilities.label: Evaluations
capabilities.value: Independent external, mid-term, and final evaluations against OECD-DAC criteria.

capabilities.label: Needs & market assessments
capabilities.value: Multi-sector needs assessments and market/economy assessments.

capabilities.label: Third-party monitoring
capabilities.value: Independent third-party monitoring and verification in access-constrained settings.

capabilities.label: Research & studies
capabilities.value: Baseline, endline, and formative research studies with mixed-methods designs.

capabilities.label: Primary data collection
capabilities.value: Household surveys, key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and remote data collection.
